g.title: fixed_hexagon
g.text: The weak sub-hexagon fixed by t, and one of the four apartments of orbit A hung on eight of its thin elements

g.title: titleW
g.text: the 40 elements fixed by t: 4 thick points, 4 thick lines and 32 thin elements

g.title: legendW
g.text: rows: the thick points, columns: the thick lines; in each cell the thin line and
thin point joining them. Blue: the eight the apartment on the right hangs from

g.title: titleA
g.text: one apartment of orbit A, hung on eight thin elements

g.title: legendA
g.text: hollow: the new vertices on its four flags; from each blue element, its two shortest paths
to the two opposite apartment vertices nearest to it, which t swaps
